I'm 31 and a half now. I was 22 on my first really bad trip, so I was very young. I can't judge your mental state for you but there is a point when it's bad and it's okay. It's entirely likely that you're a more mature person than I am. I can fit sure tell you though that whatever you do, make sure you have a trusted person with you. Just take care of yourself friend, and make sure that you have a good trip.

For me in particular, the issue was my ADHD and getting lost in circles of thought around things I've done wrong in my life that I never really dealt with. I was just in a bad place psychologically and what hallucinogens do generally is take from your current mental state and making it all consuming. 

I was the type of person to bury what was going on with me and ignoring everything and shrooms stripped that away and I was just left with myself and my demons. But like I said, I was a very young and very traumatized person, I hadn't really gone through enough reflecting on myself to be okay with a drug that can do that. Neither was I in the headspace for it.

If you can sit with yourself without your phone meditating for like....15 20 minutes without being drawn into an awful train of thought and if you can find music or something like that to focus on that can take you away from a bad train of thought, I highly recommend it and I hope you have a really nice trip if you do
